segments.name: CRE lending operations
segments.description: Originates, holds and manages commercial real estate mortgage loans and equity investments for middle-market borrowers in U.S. markets.
segments.evidence: The Company's management directs operations on a consolidated basis as a single operating segment, CRE lending operations.

revenueModel.text: Income comes mainly from the spread between interest earned on CRE loans and the cost of financing them, plus rental income from direct property equity investments.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate our income primarily from the spread between the revenues we receive from our interest-bearing assets and the cost to finance our ownership of those assets, including corporate debt.
